exposure: Changing gloves pre-closure during caesarean birth
cohort: The study cohort included data from 1590 caesarean births performed at the Royal United Hospitals Bath NHS Foundation Trust in 2023-2024, with findings extrapolated to the entire English NHS.
finding: Changing gloves pre-closure during caesarean birth was estimated to deliver significant cost-savings for local maternity services (e.g., £339,654 over 5 years at RUHB) and the English NHS as a whole (£45.1 million over 5 years) by reducing post-caesarean birth surgical site infections.
